name: Atzen
summary: Atzen (also known as Atzenstyle) is a specific German subcultural aesthetic deeply rooted in the graffiti scene, train surfing, and the Ultra movement.
description: Atzen (also known as Atzenstyle) is a specific German subcultural aesthetic deeply rooted in the graffiti scene, train surfing, and the Ultra movement. While the term "Atze" originally stems from Berlin dialect meaning "brother" or "mate," the modern iteration describes a functional, high-end, and often anonymized uniform for the urban underground.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Status, fame, graffiti
objects: partially overlapping with the Casuals style
